title: every old goal is closed, its decisions are kept, and the goals are deleted

stages.title: the registers
stages.summary: Confirms that every register of owed work names only a milestone that is still ahead.

stages.title: every old goal is read
stages.summary: Reads every goal in front of this one for unfinished work and for decisions that only its prose holds.

stages.title: finished in place
stages.summary: Builds every gap the audit found, so no gap names this goal.

stages.title: deletion becomes the rule
stages.summary: Makes the goal switch delete the goal it leaves, and removes the floor machinery that nothing reads any more.

stages.title: the old goals are deleted
stages.summary: Deletes every goal in front of this one and every citation of them.

checks.name: every goal in front of goal-closeout is named in goal-decisions.md
argv: const fs=require('fs');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/chain.json','utf8'));const t=fs.readFileSync('docs/agent/goal-decisions.md','utf8');const m=c.goals.slice(0,c.goals.indexOf('goal-closeout')).filter(s=>!t.includes('`'+s+'`'));if(m.length){console.log('not read yet: '+m.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('every goal in front of goal-closeout is read')
want: every goal in front of goal-closeout is read

checks.name: the chain starts at goal-closeout and no older goal is left
argv: const fs=require('fs');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/chain.json','utf8'));const i=c.goals.indexOf('goal-closeout');if(i!==0){console.log('goals still in front of goal-closeout: '+i);process.exit(1)}const left=fs.readdirSync('docs/agent/goals').filter(f=>f!=='README.md'&&!(f.endsWith('.md')&&c.goals.includes(f.slice(0,-3))));if(left.length){console.log('left in docs/agent/goals: '+left.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('the chain starts at goal-closeout and no older goal is left')
want: the chain starts at goal-closeout and no older goal is left
